name: qiui
title_zh: 远程管教宠物与伴侣的 QIUI 全系遥控器
tagline_zh: 不用翻文档、不用记命令，说一句“给项圈上锁”它就跑 CLI。覆盖 Cellmate、KeyPod。
tagline_en: Say "lock the collar" and it runs the CLI for you. Covers login, devices, lock/shock/vibrate/sway across.
desc_en: Operate QIUI CLI `qiui` by running it for the user across all products and actions: login, devices, lock/unlock, shock, vibrate, sway, strength, scan, write (Cellmate, 项圈, KeyPod, PearFlower, Tail, PulseBird, …). Prefer shell execution over pasting recipes. Trigger on: QIUI, Cellmate, 项圈, 电击, 上锁, 振动, KeyPod, PearFlower, Tail, qiui, shock, collar.
why_zh: 把零散命令封装成自然语言动作，直接 shell 执行而非贴配方。省去查参数、拼 flag 的功夫。
why_en: Wraps the qiui CLI into natural-language actions, executing directly in shell instead of pasting recipes. Saves flag-hunting.
limit_zh: 需要本机已装并登录 qiui CLI（含账号凭据）。只负责调用官方命令，不解析设备返回的原始状态码。
limit_en: Requires qiui CLI installed & logged in locally. Only triggers official commands; raw status codes/errors are passed through—no extra parsing or.
title_en: Full QIUI remote: lock, shock, vibrate, track
